title: Compare the embedded local gate with a genuinely matched one-band alternative
statement: At fixed P=c_plus^2+c_minus^2=3g^2,the original source has |chi|=3abg^4+O(g^6),while one accessible band gives9abg^4+O(g^6),a=4-2sqrt(3),b=4/sqrt(3)-2. Leading dressing bP and exchange magnitude aP match. The upper-only case has an invariant empty lower band even under static memory imbalance,with a small-coupling accessible gap when |epsilon|<1.
